annotations.title: Rent a space on the KillBounce Ads wall

description: Rent a rectangle of the KillBounce Ads wall (ads.killbounce.app, 3840x2160). Price = 10x10 squares x zone rate x days: phone zone $0.005, tablet $0.0025, monitor $0.002, rest $0.001 per square per day; min 100x100, 1-30 days. The 402 quote is exact and holds nothing; taken spaces are refused, not charged. Returns edit_url: POST your ad there as JSON (kind, text as simple HTML, image_base64, picture_link, bg, fg, name, town). Goes live after review. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.
